name: landing
title: Landing
description: A one-page product site. The hero with a device screen drawn from data, a band of figures, feature rows with readouts, a plan comparison table, questions and a closing call are all YAML in the front page's frontmatter. Neutral starter content; the Tidewatch example shows it finished. No plugins.

demo.tagline: Tide times that fit in a pocket

features: Hero, figures, features, plans, questions and closing call rendered from frontmatter
A phone screen and per-feature readouts drawn from data, no screenshots needed
Plan comparison table that stacks on phones
Self-hosted Barlow and Barlow Condensed, preloaded
Three prose subpages: pricing, changelog, privacy
System light and dark with a toggle

sampleContent.purpose: The front page; its frontmatter holds every section, with starter copy that explains each one
A finished product site built on this template

notes: The sample content is deliberately neutral; your product goes in pages/index.md and the scaffolder's --name
Prose pages read pages/index.md for the nav links and the button
